2025 was a watershed year for ideological content in mainstream film and television. From a Netflix sequel that scored the highest woke net in our database to a festival darling reframing parenthood as horror, the year pushed boundaries that previous years only approached. This list covers the 15 most ideologically progressive titles in VirtueVigil's 2025 review database. Not a quality ranking. A consumer protection list. If you are a conservative viewer trying to decide what to watch, you deserve to know what is coming before you press play.

Rankings are sorted by net woke score (Woke Score minus Traditional Score), highest to lowest. All scores are generated using the VirtueVigil Woke Score system.

#1 — Zootopia 2 (2025)

STRONGLY WOKE WOKE: 91.0 TRAD: 53.0 NET: +38.0 WOKE

Platform: Netflix

The highest woke net in VirtueVigil's entire 2025 database. Raw scores of woke 91 and trad 53. This Netflix animated sequel operates at an ideological intensity that dwarfs anything else released in 2025. The original Zootopia was already among the most ideologically explicit mainstream animated films ever made. This sequel doubles down on every element: systemic racism as a primary narrative engine, progressive institutional messaging, and a worldview where traditional social hierarchies exist solely to be dismantled. A net woke score of plus 38 is not an edge case. It is a statement.

Read the full VirtueVigil review

#2 — Bugonia (2025)

STRONGLY WOKE WOKE: 28.94 TRAD: 8.48 NET: +20.46 WOKE

Platform: Streaming

A net woke score of plus 20.46 places Bugonia firmly in the top tier of 2025 ideological cinema. Horror genre packaging delivering progressive themes around identity, bodily autonomy, and systemic critique. Horror is Hollywood's most reliable testing ground for transgressive ideology, and Bugonia is a textbook example. The raw scores reflect a film that is not subtle about where it stands.

#3 — Clown in a Cornfield (2025)

STRONGLY WOKE WOKE: 23.0 TRAD: 5.0 NET: +18.0 WOKE

Platform: Theatrical

Net woke plus 18. Clown in a Cornfield inverts the traditional slasher formula: small-town traditionalism is monstrous, progressive outsiders are the moral center. This is a deliberate ideological inversion of classic genre setup. Conservative viewers are the explicit antagonists of this film's worldview. A trad score of 5 confirms almost no counterweight to the progressive framing.

#4 — The Wedding Banquet (2025)

STRONGLY WOKE WOKE: 19.0 TRAD: 4.0 NET: +15.0 WOKE

Platform: Theatrical

With a trad score of only 4, The Wedding Banquet offers almost no traditional counterweight to its woke score of 19, producing a net of plus 15. The film presents queer identity and non-traditional family structures as the unambiguous moral center, with traditional family expectations framed consistently as the obstacle. A remake of Ang Lee's 1993 original with full ideological commitment to contemporary progressive values.

#10 — The Ugly Stepsister (2025)

WOKE WOKE: 18.12 TRAD: 11.24 NET: +6.88 WOKE

Platform: Streaming

Body horror reimagining of Cinderella from the stepsister's perspective. Net woke plus 6.88. Uses fairy tale horror to deliver feminist critique of beauty standards, female competition, and patriarchal social structures. Technically accomplished and emotionally committed, which makes its ideological messaging more potent. The trad score of 11.24 reflects some fairy tale structure. The woke score of 18.12 reflects where the film's sympathies consistently lie.

#15 — Captain America: Brave New World (2025)

MIXED WOKE: 14.58 TRAD: 10.08 NET: +4.5 WOKE

Platform: Theatrical / Disney+

Net woke plus 4.5. Mixed score reflects the MCU's tendency to package contemporary political themes inside franchise mechanics. Surveillance, racial justice framing, and government overreach sit alongside traditional superhero heroism content. The tension between those two registers is the defining characteristic of this film's ideological profile. Exactly the kind of mixed signal that makes it harder for conservative viewers to calibrate without a resource like VirtueVigil.

What 2025 Tells Us About 2026

The Zootopia 2 number (net woke plus 38) stands apart from everything else on this list. It is the kind of score that redefines the ceiling. If an animated children's sequel can post those numbers, the question for 2026 is not whether the ceiling will be tested again, it is which film will do it.

The pattern in positions two through eight tells a different story: horror and genre films as the primary delivery mechanism. Bugonia, Clown in a Cornfield, Presence, The Ugly Stepsister. The genre is the vehicle. The ideology is the cargo. That pattern will continue in 2026.
